raw_text: We are aware that scenes from our 2023 production are being circulated on social media as real military footage. We categorically state that this is a work of fiction created for entertainment purposes. The film involved professional actors, CGI effects, and was shot on controlled sets. We request social media users to stop sharing our copyrighted content with false captions. Legal action is being considered against accounts misrepresenting our content.
clean_text: Film production house confirms viral military footage is from their 2023 movie. Work of fiction with actors and CGI. Requests users stop sharing with false captions. Legal action considered.
